::: {.callout-note}
## Not yet written

This page organizes the same material by method rather than by problem: what inverse probability
weighting, the parametric g-formula, marginal structural models, g-estimation, cloning with
censoring and weighting, sequential nested trials and longitudinal targeted learning each
identify, what each assumes, and where each breaks.

It is written once the entries it summarizes have been audited, so that a claim about where a
method breaks carries the same verdict as the entry it came from.

Browse [the catalog](catalog.qmd) in the meantime, or read
[how this was verified](methods.qmd).
:::
